ru: На доках Ливерпуля эхо повторяет чужие слова в косвенной речи: She said she was tired. Альтаир просит передать сказанное без искажений.
en: At Liverpool docks the echo repeats others' words in reported speech: She said she was tired. Altair asks you to relay what was said without distortion.
es: En los muelles de Liverpool el eco repite en estilo indirecto: She said she was tired. Altair pide transmitir sin distorsión.
de: An den Liverpooler Docks wiederholt das Echo indirekte Rede: She said she was tired. Altair verlangt korrekte Wiedergabe.
